basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Anatomy, Pharmacology Posts
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Mangalagiri has 2 Tutor/Demonstrator vacancies on a one-year contract, one in Anatomy and one in Pharmacology. Both medical and non-medical candidates can apply through a Google Form until 21 November 2026. Basic pay is Rs. 56,100 at Level 10, and the upper age limit is 37 years. This is not a walk-in recruitment, so candidates must apply online before attending any selection stage.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid by NEFT/UPI into the account below and is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 37 years as on the closing date of applications.

how_to_apply: Pay the application fee by NEFT/UPI, if applicable, and keep the transaction details.
Fill and sign the application form (Annexure I) and the proforma/check list (Annexure II), both printed at the end of the notice.
Open the Google Form for Tutor/Demonstrator applications. The link can also be pasted into a browser's address bar.
Fill the form and submit the scanned application form in the prescribed format, with the necessary documents and transaction details, only through this link.
Bring the hard copies of Annexure I and II to document verification, which takes place before the interview.
Bring the originals and one set of self-attested photocopies, arranged in this order:
Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.)
Address proof (Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.)
Certificate showing date of birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate)
Two recent passport size photographs
Class SSC/10th and 12th certificates
MBBS/M.Sc mark sheets and degree certificate
Internship certificate for MBBS candidates
Experience certificate, if any
FMGE certificate conducted by NBE, for MBBS candidates who graduated outside India
Registration with MCI/State Medical Council, for medical graduates only
Reservation category certificate (OBC/SC/ST/PwBD)
Copy of NEFT/UPI details in original
No Objection Certificate from the employer, for in-service candidates
PwBD certificate issued by a duly constituted Medical Board of State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions
The check list in Annexure II also lists an attempt certificate (for MBBS and post graduation), publications and any other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Mangalagiri
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri is a healthcare Institute of National Importance in Andhra Pradesh. It was established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojna (PMSSY).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Tutor/Demonstrator Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Usual allowances as admissible under the rules are paid on top of basic pay, including NPA for medical candidates. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Tutor/Demonstrator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 37 years as on the closing date of applications. Essential: A medical qualification included in the I or II schedule or Part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956. Persons with qualifications in Part II or the third schedule should also fulfil the conditions in section 13 (3) of the Act. Internship: 1 year of compulsory internship must be completed. Preferred: MD/MS from a recognized University/Institute in the concerned subject. Registration: NMC (MCI)/State registration is mandatory before joining, if selected. Essential: Postgraduate qualification, e.g. Master's degree in the discipline/allied subject. Preferred: Ph.D from a recognized University/Institute in the concerned subject. OBC (non-creamy layer) and EWS certificates must be valid and issued on or after 01 April 2026. OBC candidates must not belong to the creamy layer, and their sub-caste must match the Central List of OBC. SC, ST, OBC and EWS certificates should be issued by a Tahsildar or an authority of higher rank, in the prescribed format. PwBD reservation applies only to persons with not less than 40% physical disability, supported by a Disability Certificate from a competent authority. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: The fee is paid by NEFT/UPI into the account below and is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document screening: The Screening Committee checks the documents before the interview. Only candidates it declares eligible are allowed to attend. Written examination: If the number of applicants is more, an MCQ-based examination in the subject concerned will be conducted. Interview: The interview is held in physical mode at the Admin and Library Building, AIIMS Mangalagiri, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh. When a written examination is held, shortlisted candidates go on to the interview. Attending the interview does not guarantee selection. A wait list may be maintained, and vacancies arising from non-joining or resignation will be offered from it according to merit. A candidate's turn for interview may be delayed depending on the number of applicants.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for both Anatomy and Pharmacology?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the essential qualification for each post. The fee must be paid separately for each department.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice clearly says "No Walk-in Interview", so you must apply through the Google Form by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can non-medical candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. They need a postgraduate qualification, such as a Master's degree in the discipline or an allied subject.

faq.question: Q4. Is MD/MS or Ph.D compulsory?
faq.answer: No. MD/MS is preferred for medical candidates and Ph.D for non-medical candidates, but neither is listed as essential.

faq.question: Q5. Will there be a written examination?
faq.answer: Only if the number of applicants is more. It will be MCQ-based, in the subject concerned, and will be followed by the interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or Autonomous Institutions must produce the original NOC, or they will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The NOC must state that the candidate will be permitted to join AIIMS Mangalagiri if selected.

faq.question: Q7. Can I resign before the contract ends?
faq.answer: Yes, but not within 03 months from the date of joining. After that you must give 01 month's notice or pay salary in lieu of it.

faq.question: Q8. How long will I get to join after selection?
faq.answer: Selected candidates get 14 days to join. The Competent Authority may grant an extension in exceptional situations with reasonable justification, and no further extension is permitted after that.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I send questions about the advertisement?
faq.answer: Send them to [email protected]. Updates on the selection process will appear on the Institute's website.
